abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, and MODIFY_DEFENSE_VALUE wrote combat.total_defense, which _resolve_damage recomputes from sum(card.defense) immediately before damage -- so the value was discarded even when something did set it. WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_DEFENSE with MODIFY_DEFENSE moves the DEFENDING CARD's own {d}, which is what survives into the total. The condition was a bare IN_COMBAT, which is true for every card in every combat and says nothing about which cards are defending.

"put a card from your hand ON TOP of your deck" was authored with position:"top"; the effect reads "to", so the card went to the BOTTOM -- the opposite end of the deck, and for a card whose point is setting up the next draw, the opposite effect. It was also optional by default while the text is mandatory. "position" is now read as well, since it is the natural third spelling.
